digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live reconciliation verification suite
propositions: Prove rebar reconciles bidirectionally against a Dockerized Jira DC instance using a copy of the real ticket store, since a pass over an empty store cannot distinguish converged from working.
The working store copy must be a separate repo with no git remote and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, with isolation asserted rather than assumed to prevent test mutations pushing to the real project.
The store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding and snapshot artifacts (including the .bak-retarget backup), enumerated from the tree rather than a hardcoded list.
The store copy must be verified by counting local tickets directly on the filesystem against the fetched tickets branch, not by the pass's scanned number which counts remote Jira issues.

Each of 28 inbound/outbound mutation cells must round-trip against a named oracle individually, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport via pytest.raises(NotImplementedError).
--filter-local-ids failed to match an inbound create because its target is the raw Jira key while the binding did not yet exist; fixed by passing both the local id and the Jira key.
